description: This file implements the 'git difftool' command, providing functionalities for directory and file diffs using external tools, including configuration handling, subprocess management, parsing diff info, handling symlinks, submodules, and integration with git's index. It includes functions to manage temporary directories, generate diff views, and process user options.

methods.name: int difftool_config(const char * var,const char * value,const struct config_context * ctx,void * cb)
methods.description: Handles configuration options for the difftool command, setting trust_exit_code and symlinks based on git config variables.

methods.name: int print_tool_help(void)
methods.description: Executes a command to display available diff tools and their help information.

methods.name: int parse_index_info(struct repository * repo,char * p,int * mode1,int * mode2,struct object_id * oid1,struct object_id * oid2,char * status)
methods.description: Parses a line of index info from diff output to extract mode, object IDs, and status.

methods.name: void add_path(struct strbuf * buf,size_t base_len,const char * path)
methods.description: Removes trailing slash from base path and appends a new subpath.

methods.name: int use_wt_file(struct repository * repo,const char * workdir,const char * name,struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Determines if a working tree file can be reused based on SHA-1 comparison.

methods.name: char * get_symlink(struct repository * repo,struct difftool_options * dt_options,const struct object_id * oid,const char * path)
methods.description: Retrieves symlink contents, either from the filesystem or from the object database, depending on whether the object is known.

methods.name: int checkout_path(unsigned mode,struct object_id * oid,const char * path,const struct checkout * state)
methods.description: Checks out a specific file path from the repository objects into the working directory.

methods.name: void write_file_in_directory(struct repository * repo,struct strbuf * dir,size_t dir_len,const char * path,const char * content)
methods.description: Writes contents to a file within a designated directory, creating necessary directories.

methods.name: void write_standin_files(struct repository * repo,struct pair_entry * entry,struct strbuf * ldir,size_t ldir_len,struct strbuf * rdir,size_t rdir_len)
methods.description: Creates placeholder files for submodules and symlinks for difftool comparisons.

methods.name: int run_dir_diff(struct repository * repo,struct difftool_options * dt_options,const char * extcmd,const char * prefix,struct child_process * child)
methods.description: Performs a directory diff by setting up temporary directories, collecting diff info, and invoking external diff tools.

methods.name: int run_file_diff(int prompt,const char * prefix,struct child_process * child)
methods.description: Runs a diff on individual files, setting environment variables to configure the diff tool behavior.

methods.name: int cmd_difftool(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Main function to handle the 'git difftool' command, parsing options, setting environment, and dispatching to directory or file diff routines.
